summary: Alpine Agency of the Midlands LLC, a South Carolina-based health and benefits insurance agency, disclosed a data breach affecting individuals in the United States. Unauthorized access to a company email account began on or about October 28, 2025, and was discovered in November 2025 when Alpine identified unusual account activity. The compromised email account contained personal information including names, Social Security numbers, dates of birth, addresses, government IDs, and health insurance information. The breach was reported to the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services on July 13, 2026, with affected individuals notified by first-class mail.
